_note: Known new-feature deltas of the Python backend vs the legacy bash (issue #12). Each entry pins the exact signature observed on dooracle at origin/main 28377c3 (2026-11-16); if a diff under an allowlisted case no longer has that signature, the harness reports KNOWN-CHANGED and fails instead of going green. Update an entry only after confirming the new shape is still the intended behaviour, and record the new observation.

preset-*.json.observed: py-only lines '"windowGapsIn": 6,' and '"windowsGeometry": {' (value is the live windows.json)
preset-*.json.reason: Applying a preset snapshots the live windows.json geometry into the saved doc as 'windowsGeometry' (apply_ops.py: snapshot for rollback, restored verbatim by apply_form_sections); the legacy bash never recorded it.

preset-save.observed: py-only lines '"windowGapsIn": 6,' and '"windowsGeometry": {' (value is the live windows.json)
preset-save.reason: Saving a preset snapshots the live windows.json geometry into the saved preset as 'windowsGeometry' (same rollback snapshot); the legacy bash never recorded it.

style-*.json.observed: py-only lines '"windowGapsIn": 6,' and '"windowsGeometry": {' (value is the live windows.json)
style-*.json.reason: Applying a style snapshots the live windows.json geometry into last-preset.json as 'windowsGeometry' (same rollback snapshot as presets); the legacy bash never recorded it.

style-save.observed: py-only lines '"windowGapsIn": 6,' and '"windowsGeometry": {' (value is the live windows.json)
style-save.reason: Saving a style snapshots the live windows.json geometry into the saved style as 'windowsGeometry' (same rollback snapshot); the legacy bash never recorded it.

thumbs.observed: calls.log 15 vs 24 lines; py-only calls thumbnail catppuccin-latte, catppuccin, flexoki-light, kanagawa, matte-black, nord from /usr/share
thumbs.reason: Python thumbnails the system copies of theme previews too (PR #9 preview fallback); the legacy bash only thumbnails previews it can see, so it makes fewer vipsthumbnail calls.

available.observed: first differing line: bash 'lock' vs python 'dock'
available.reason: Python lists the new Dock category; the legacy bash has no dock list (new feature, no bash equivalent).

list bar-widgets.observed: first differing line: bash 'Widget settings section:settings' vs python 'DOT-MATRIX logo tweak:w:dotmatrix-mark'
list bar-widgets.reason: Python lists 5 not-on-bar modules the legacy bash never enumerated (active-app, battery-gauge, dot-clock, dotmatrix-mark, privacy-led); bash output is a strict subset (37 vs 42 rows).

list dock.observed: bash output empty, python prints the full Dock list
list dock.reason: New Dock list exists only in the Python backend; the legacy bash prints nothing for it.

expect: The screen as a printed page
list shaders.observed: python first line 'Reading mode (now: off) reading', bash 'bettercrt bettercrt .../bettercrt.frag 1'
list shaders.reason: Python prepends toggle/next/reading action rows; the legacy bash lists shader files only.

list theme-switcher.observed: no differing line in the common prefix — python has 2 extra trailing rows
list theme-switcher.reason: Python offers the honeycomb and dots switcher styles; the legacy bash stops at polaroid (21 vs 19 rows).

list theme-walls.observed: python first line 'Static wallpapers section:Static wallpapers', bash a bare file row
list theme-walls.reason: Python groups theme wallpapers under section headers (Static/Favourites/Live); the legacy bash prints bare file rows.

list themes.observed: bash preview field empty, python '/usr/share/omarchy/themes/tokyo-night/preview.png' for tokyo-night
list themes.reason: Python falls back to the system copy for a theme preview (PR #9); the legacy bash leaves the preview empty when the user copy has none.

list wallpaper-fx.observed: python first line 'Wallpaper FX is off — turn it on enable-plugin', bash 'Duration, ms: 420 tweak:duration'
list wallpaper-fx.reason: Python shows an enable-plugin row while the FX plugin is installed but off; the legacy bash lists tweaks only.
